exec_block_rules.when: any execution, mutation, training, promotion, or deployment is requested

capabilities.description: Describe executor, session, budget, fork, replay, and sharing seams without operating them.
capabilities.name: plan_omnigent_session_operation

claim_boundary: Source-only contract for OMNI-002. It defines the proposal and evidence boundary only; it does not invoke a provider, mutate runtime state, authorize training or promotion, activate OmniGent, or deploy to any host.

delta_c.rule: This interface remains source-only and proposal-only.

pitfalls: replay changes model-visible history or planning mutates budget, ACL, or worktree state

input_contract.consumer: Kalcypher rungs A through E and OmniGent operator UI
input_contract.required: session, agent, host, budget, worktree, and permission identities

output_contract.failure: a content-free typed blocker with no partial authority
output_contract.success: a source-only session-operation plan or typed blocker
output_contract.verification: an independent source critic reopens the exact bytes

done_definition: the source-only output is deterministic and bounded
no runtime or operational proof is inferred
preconditions: the exact contract hash is bound
all inputs are source-visible and content-addressed
execution, training, promotion, and deployment authority are false
repair_on_failure: repair the source contract or evidence binding and request a fresh review
do not bypass the typed blocker with an unregistered provider or route
steps: 1. Reopen the exact input and contract bytes.
2. Validate the bounded source-only request and preserve authority as false.
3. Return a proposal/report or a typed blocker without downstream invocation.
